families.label: 空手
families.held: empty bare hands, no weapon, no shield, no scabbard, relaxed fists
families.attack: a compact forward straight punch with a clear windup, fully extended fist to RIGHT, then recovery

families.label: 單手盾
families.held: one small round wooden-and-bronze shield strapped to LEFT forearm, right hand empty, no sword or other weapon
families.attack: brace the round shield close to torso then a forceful forward shield bash to RIGHT and recoil, right hand stays empty

families.label: 單手武器
families.held: a single curved one-handed saber in right hand, left hand free
families.attack: Draw weapon back with coiled waist, step and make a forceful diagonal cut with compact bright crescent slash then follow through

families.label: 長柄武器
families.held: a compact long spear held in both hands diagonally, keep the whole spear visible
families.attack: Pull spear back, lower stance, powerful two-handed forward thrust then recover

families.label: 雙手重刃
families.held: a broad two-handed greatsword with long grip, both hands grasping it
families.attack: Both hands lift heavy sword over shoulder, strong overhead diagonal chop and weighty follow-through

families.label: 投擲武器
families.held: two small metal throwing daggers, one drawn in right hand and one in belt
families.attack: Raise throwing arm behind shoulder, twist torso then whip arm forward releasing one tiny dagger with a short motion trace, draw replacement

families.label: 弓
families.held: a recurved wooden bow in left hand, arrow and small quiver on back
families.attack: Nock arrow, pull string fully to cheek, aim right, release arrow with recoil and lower bow

families.label: 弩
families.held: a wood and steel compact crossbow held with both hands
families.attack: Cock crossbow, raise stock to shoulder, aim right, release a single bolt with recoil, lower and reload

families.label: 單手法杖
families.held: a short crystal-tipped magic wand in right hand, left hand free
families.attack: Gather a small turquoise spark around the wand, point right and discharge compact magic burst, settle

families.label: 雙手法杖
families.held: a long crystal-tipped staff grasped in both hands
families.attack: Brace staff in both hands, draw energy into the tip then thrust forward releasing a compact gold magic burst, settle

families.label: 管樂器
families.held: a short ornate wooden flute held in both hands
families.attack: Lift flute to lips and visibly play it with changing hand positions, compact golden sound rings appear near bell, lower flute

families.label: 弦樂器
families.held: a small wooden lute held across torso, one hand fretting and other strumming
families.attack: Bring lute into playing position, fingers strum rhythmically, small compact golden musical sparks, then settle

families.label: 打擊樂器
families.held: a round frame drum held in left hand and played with right palm
families.attack: Raise drum, right palm hits drum face with two rhythmic beats and small golden sound rings, then settle

families.label: 單手武器與盾
families.held: a one-handed saber in right hand and a small ROUND SHIELD strapped to left forearm
families.attack: Brace shield, draw saber back and make forceful diagonal cut past shield then recover; guard MUST raise shield, not saber

families.label: 雙手大盾
families.held: one large tall tower shield held with BOTH HANDS, no blade
families.attack: Brace behind shield, crouch and forcefully shove heavy shield forward for shield bash then recover; guard covers entire torso behind shield

families.label: 雙持武器
families.held: two short curved sabers, one in each hand
families.attack: Coil then make a strong crossing double cut, left then right blade, compact crossed slash streaks; guard crosses BOTH blades
